name: Interaction reference heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: File ownership framing
does: States that this file owns conversation rules and the engine owns state semantics.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Gates heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Exactly two human gates
does: Only the goals(+mock) gate and the acceptance pass involve the human; everything between self-approves.
preventsClaim: a run that stalls waiting on a human between stages

name: Never ask approval for requirements
does: The user is never asked to approve requirements or a plan.
preventsClaim: approval fatigue on intermediate artifacts

name: Human gate heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Ask for approval explicitly
does: After presenting artifacts, ask "Approve goals<and mocks>, or what should change?".
preventsClaim: an implicit approval the user never gave

name: Silence is not approval
does: Feedback, questions, or silence are not approval: revise and re-present until the user says yes.
preventsClaim: advancing on an unapproved artifact
costNote: exit: explicit yes; no iteration bound

name: Record goals approval with route
does: On approval run `approve <dir> goals route=…`, and on the full route `approve <dir> mock` after it.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Decide route before gating
does: Decide the route before the gate; it is recorded with the approval.
preventsClaim: an approval recorded without a route

name: Changed re-approval cascades
does: A changed re-approval deletes every later stage's approval.
preventsClaim: downstream artifacts surviving a change to what they were built from
costNote: re-runs every later stage, each with its own critic loop

name: Commit the goals approval
does: Commit artifacts plus .workflow-state as `mise: approve goals`.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Continue in-session after gate
does: Re-run the state engine and dispatch the next stage without ending the turn.
preventsClaim: the user having to re-invoke the skill after approving

name: Friction log heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Friction log file and format
does: Append `<stage or task>: <what happened>` to _friction.md, creating it, and include it in the next checkpoint commit.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: friction lost before the retrospective)
costNote: 1 append per friction event; ~8 call sites across the flow

name: Only retrospective reads friction
does: Only the retrospective role reads the friction log.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the log re-entering the driver's context)

name: Log every user correction
does: While work is in flight, log every chat message correcting the workflow's output or approach.
preventsClaim: repeat corrections never reaching the retrospective
costNote: 1 append per correcting user message, any stage

name: Gate iteration is not friction
does: Goals-gate iteration on the artifacts is not logged.
preventsClaim: the friction log filling with normal gate conversation

name: Acceptance flag logged once
does: An acceptance flag is logged once as its own line.
preventsClaim: double-logging a flagged acceptance item

name: Critic gate heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Dispatch a critic
does: After writing the artifact, dispatch roles/critic.md as a synchronous general-purpose Agent.
preventsClaim: an artifact reaching the next stage unreviewed
costNote: 1 critic per round, per artifact version; requirements and plan both use it

name: Critic prompt template
does: Fixed prompt: artifact path, kind, upstream paths, config path, all absolute.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a critic without its upstream docs)

name: Then lead-in
does: Lead-in to the critic loop steps.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Zero blocking findings passes
does: Zero blocking findings is a pass; a fresh critic always finds something.
preventsClaim: chasing a clean report that will never come

name: Apply minor findings silently
does: Apply worthwhile minor findings without re-dispatching a critic.
preventsClaim: an extra critic round for non-blocking findings

name: Blockers trigger a new round
does: Blocking findings mean revise and re-dispatch a fresh critic.
preventsClaim: shipping an artifact with known blocking defects
costNote: exit: zero blockers, a stall trigger, or the budget; 1 critic per iteration

name: Classify against all rounds
does: Classify each blocker against all prior rounds: the same defect reworded is recurring, anything else fresh.
preventsClaim: a reworded repeat defect reading as progress
costNote: driver holds every round's blocking findings

name: Counts never decide
does: Finding counts never decide whether the loop continues.
preventsClaim: a shrinking finding count being read as convergence

name: All fresh keeps iterating
does: If every blocker is fresh, revise and re-dispatch.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Log each recurrence event
does: Every recurring blocker is one recurrence event, logged with its short name and sighting number.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: stalls invisible to the retrospective)

name: First recurrence earns one retry
does: The loop's first recurrence event earns that blocker one more fix attempt unless a stall trigger fires.
preventsClaim: stalling on the first repeat of a fixable defect

name: Three stall triggers
does: Stall on third sighting, ping-pong (a second recurrence on a different blocker), or budget exhausted.
preventsClaim: a critic loop that never converges burning rounds

name: Budget five, ceiling eight
does: 5 rounds per artifact version, never scaled by task count; ceiling 8 across resets.
preventsClaim: unbounded critic spend on one artifact
costNote: hard cap: 8 critic spawns per artifact, so 16 per full run (requirements + plan)

name: Rewrite resets the budget
does: A substantial mid-loop rewrite resets the budget, the recurrence memory, and the event count.
preventsClaim: a rewritten artifact inheriting an exhausted budget
costNote: resets up to the ceiling of 8

name: User round may exceed budget
does: A user-directed round after a stall may exceed either budget and inherits the loop's memory.
preventsClaim: the budget blocking a round the user asked for

name: Stall stops and presents
does: At a stall, log friction, stop, and present the artifact, per-round counts, labeled blockers, and the trigger.
preventsClaim: looping forever instead of handing the decision back
costNote: 1 user turn; the only human stop between the two gates

name: Log multi-round passes
does: On a pass that took more than one round, log rounds and blocking counts per round.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: slow convergence invisible later)

name: Approve stage and continue
does: Run `approve <dir> <stage>`, commit `mise: approve <stage>`, continue in-session; mention cleared_done IDs.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: 1 node run + 1 commit per critic gate pass

name: Assumptions section heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: No questions past goals
does: Stages past the goals gate never ask clarifying questions; infer defaults from docs, codebase, and config.
preventsClaim: a stage stalling on a human who is no longer present

name: Record inferences, stop on blockers
does: Record every non-obvious inference in Assumptions; stop and ask only on a contradiction or irreducible gap.
preventsClaim: silent inferences, and stalling on resolvable gaps

name: Model routing heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Seven named subagent roles
does: Names the seven roles and where each is dispatched: implementer, reviewer, critic, acceptance, explore, documenter, retrospective.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: unroutable model assignments)
costNote: the complete spawn-point catalogue for the flow

name: Session model when unassigned
does: No ## Models section, no entry, or the value session means pass no model parameter.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Model never blocks dispatch
does: If the harness Agent tool has no model override, dispatch without one.
preventsClaim: a model assignment blocking a dispatch

name: Asking questions heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: One to three numbered questions
does: Ask 1-3 related questions per turn, numbered, with lettered choices one per line.
preventsClaim: question sets the user cannot answer compactly
costNote: caps a turn at 3 questions, so multi-item interviews take several turns

name: Question format example
does: Worked example of the numbered question and lettered choice layout.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Always end with a recommendation
does: End every question set with a recommendation line, picking one even when torn.
preventsClaim: handing the user an unopinionated menu

name: Recommendation line format
does: Shows the Recommend line with the rec reply hint.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Reasons and the rec shortcut
does: Brief reason after non-obvious picks; the line always ends with the rec hint; a bare letter isn't it.
preventsClaim: a bare option letter being read as the accept-all shortcut

name: Number every pickable list
does: Number any other list the user might pick from or refer back to.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: ambiguous references to list items)
